title: Descent of morphisms between perfect complexes
statement: Let (R_i)_{i\in I} be a filtered system of rings with colimit R, fix i\in I, and let X_i be a finitely presented R_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Put X_j=X_i \times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} \operatorname{Spec}(R_j) for j\ge i and X=X_i \times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} \operatorname{Spec}(R). Let P_i and Q_i be perfect objects of D(O_{X_i}) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex], and write P_j,Q_j and P,Q for their derived pullbacks to X_j and X, respectively. Every morphism f:P\to Q in D(O_X) is, after replacing i by a later index j, the pullback of a morphism f_j:P_j\to Q_j; moreover, if f is an isomorphism then j may be chosen so that f_j is an isomorphism, and finitely many prescribed equalities between such morphisms hold at the same later index.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.29.2, Tag 09RE, label lemma-descend-homomorphisms (full faithfulness), used in Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF

proof.text: Apply cofinal-tail Hom continuity to lift the given limit morphism to a finite stage. If it is invertible, apply the same continuity with Q,P at a tail beginning at that stage to lift its inverse. Transport the first lift to the inverse's stage; limit-stage compatibility identifies its limit image with the original morphism.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.29.2, Tag 09RE, label lemma-descend-homomorphisms (full faithfulness), used in Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF

proof.text: Transport preserves identity and composition by functoriality and cancellation of the fixed comparison components. The two lifted composites have the same limit images as the identities. Apply tail equality for P,P and Q,Q, and directedness to satisfy the two inverse identities at a common stage. These identities define an IsIso instance on the transported lift. Cancel the comparison components to recover the exact representation equation of the original statement.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.29.2, Tag 09RE, label lemma-descend-homomorphisms (full faithfulness), used in Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF

proof.text: For each equality in the finite family, conjugate the raw pullback equation by the fixed comparison components and apply tail equality. Choose an upper bound of the finite set of resulting stages and then a common upper bound with the starting stage. At this stage every equality holds. Cancel the comparison components to get the raw pullback equalities required by the original statement. When the family is empty the starting stage ensures a valid witness.
